dist_to_segment.description: Orthogonal Euclidean distance from GPS point to candidate road arc segment.

dist_to_u.description: Euclidean distance from GPS point to incoming road junction node u.

dist_to_v.description: Euclidean distance from GPS point to outgoing road junction node v.

dist_to_midpoint.description: Euclidean distance from GPS point to the midpoint of the road arc segment.

arc_length.description: Metric length of the candidate road arc segment.

proj_ratio.description: Normalized scalar projection parameter t along segment (0.0 = node u, 1.0 = node v).

speed.description: Instantaneous vehicular speed computed via causal backward differences.

dist_rank.description: Proximity rank order among all generated candidate arcs for the GPS point.

relative_dist.description: Ratio of candidate orthogonal distance to the nearest candidate arc distance.

delta_x.description: Signed residual along the local tangent plane East-West axis (x_gps - x_proj).

delta_y.description: Signed residual along the local tangent plane North-South axis (y_gps - y_proj).

heading_cos.description: Cosine of angular difference between travel heading and directed road arc azimuth.

min_node_dist.description: Minimum distance to either endpoint node min(dist_to_u, dist_to_v).

node_asymmetry.description: Absolute difference between distance to entry node and distance to exit node.
